expires_today.title: Big Blast'n Sounds for Game Devs
expires_today.description: Big blast’n sounds for any situation!
expires_today.long_description: Level up your audioscape with big‑time firepower—reload your asset library with the Big Blast’n Sounds for Game Devs Bundle. Choose from full, royalty‑free soundtracks and samples with unmatched versatility, and seamlessly add Hollywood‑quality sound design without the hassle of asset sourcing! Utilize the Electronic Techno Soundtrack Part 1–2 for your cyberpunk titles or the Heavy Metal Music Collection for your next boomer‑shooter. Never pay full price for audio assets again, and snag this amazing deal before it’s gone! Pay what you want for a gigantic library of audio assets for your next game and help support the IGDA Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Dying Earth RPG Collection
expires_today.long_description: Enter a decadent world of wit and danger with The Dying Earth Roleplaying Game. Drawn from the classic tales of fantasy titan Jack Vance, prime inspiration for the settings, moods and spells of Dungeons & Dragons, and designed by roleplaying legend Robin D. Laws.  Explore a wondrous, exhausted world. Trade pleasantries with its ravenous and articulate creatures. Match wits with rogues, merchants and arch-magicians, and pray your tongue is the sharper.  The entire game line of rules, settings, maps and lore, yours for the merest pittance! Before the flickering sun winks out for good and takes this bundle with it.  And should prying fools dare question you, explain that your purchase is motivated not by greed for absurdly good and fleeting bargains, but by pure charitable feeling toward the World Wildlife Fund.

Turn your imagination and inspiration into a thoughtful blueprint for your home’s future this summer with the ultimate home design bundle from Richdale Ventures! Unlock professional-grade personal CAD software that helps you reimagine every inch of your property, from the bathroom to the backyard. Save big on ArchiMaster 3D, the hottest home-design platform, before this amazing deal disappears, and help support the American Cancer Society with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before December 31st, 2026.

expires_today.title: The EC Comics Artists Library by Fantagraphics
expires_today.description: Celebrate the art of these fantastic comics
expires_today.long_description: Comics need great writers, sure, but they’d be nothing without the talented artists who put their blood, sweat, and tears into bringing these stories to life on the page. Our latest bundle in partnership with Fantagraphics celebrates the iconic artists behind EC Comics’ greatest hits! See the world of Ray Bradbury’s short stories like never before in Home to Stay! The Complete Ray Bradbury EC Stories illustrated by the likes of Reed Crandall, Frank Frazetta, Al Williamson, Wallace Wood, and more! Dive into the work of your favorite artists in collections like Jack Kamen’s Kamen’s Kalamity, Harvey Kurtzman’s Man and Superman, Jack Davis’ ’Taint the Meat… It’s The Humanity!, and Reed Crandall’s The High Cost of Dying. Get 40 collections highlighting EC Comics’ greatest artists for the price of your choice, and support Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Dread and Dark Fantasies RPG Collection
expires_tomorrow.description: Explore the depths of dark fantasy RPGs
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
We’ve cast a savings spell on an epic collection of great games with the all‑new Dread and Dark Fantasies RPG Collection. Set sail for new lands in Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire, the isometric RPG adventure filled with new content and retro‑inspired visuals; unlock three modern classics for one low price with the Torchlight I‑III Bundle; or experience the prequel sensation, DARKSIDERS: Genesis. Play these and six more of the best dark fantasy RPGs today, and help support Comic Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 18th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Masters of the Craft: A Megabundle by Valiant Entertainment
expires_tomorrow.description: THE LEGENDS OF VALIANT — ALL IN ONE INCREDIBLE COLLECTION
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Some of the greatest writers and artists in comics have left their mark on the Valiant Universe. Now, their extraordinary work comes together in one massive Humble Bundle. Experience Valiant through the work of legendary and acclaimed artists including Joe Quesada, Barry Windsor-Smith, Bob Layton, Cary Nord, Clayton Crain, Mico Suayan, and Lewis LaRosa — artists whose unforgettable imagery helped define Valiant across generations. And the stories are just as extraordinary. Discover groundbreaking work from an incredible roster of writers including Jim Shooter, Christopher Priest, Jeff Lemire, Matt Kindt, Robert Venditti, Joshua Dysart, Fred Van Lente, and Cullen Bunn — creators who helped build, reinvent, and expand one of the most acclaimed superhero universes in comics. From X-O Manowar and Bloodshot to Harbinger, Eternal Warrior, Shadowman and beyond, this isn't simply a collection of great Valiant stories. It's a showcase of the creators who made Valiant legendary. Explore an incredible collection of Valiant comics, choose your price, and support BINC with your purchase. The heroes are iconic. The creators are legendary. The Valiant Universe is yours.

expires_tomorrow.title: PAX West 2026 Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Play the best of PAX West!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Get ready to celebrate the best of nerd culture with this bundle of games in partnership with PAX West 2026! Command your heroes to victory against the Asverellian Empire in turn-based RPG Dark Deity 2! Skid and drift through the retro delights of Parking Garage Rally Circuit! Play ruthless strategy games against demonic enemies in Order Automatica! Take on the powers of gods and battle enemies solo or in co-op mode in GODBREAKERS! There’s even more nerdy fun to enjoy in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choice, tune in to this year’s PAX West celebration, and support Child’s Play charity with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 18th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Love Letter to Lovecraft
expires_tomorrow.description: Our love letter to Lovecraftian gaming
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
With blood dripping from our hands, we present the Love Letter to Lovecraft Bundle. Fight to rebuild what was lost as one of the last humans living in Remnant: From the Ashes, a soulslike action-adventure rooted in Eldritch themes. Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares imaginable before you go insane in Forgive Me Father 2 Deluxe Edition, a hand-drawn Lovecraftian boomer shooter. Or maybe psychological horror is your thing—investigate the mysterious and tragic death of the Hawkins family in Call of Cthulhu. Pay what you want for thrilling experiences in gaming and help support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.
